item.title: Opendoor Posts $883M Q2 Revenue as Executives Outline AI-Driven Strategy
item.summary: Opendoor Technologies reported $883M in Q2 2026 revenue, up 23% quarter over quarter; journalist Sophia Dew conducted a post-earnings interview with the CEO, Chief AI Officer, and CIO, which co-founder and board chairman Keith Rabois reposted on X.
